title: Better Totem Counter
description: Totem count above your hotbar, plus totem-pop counts above player nametags. Extra features, like reset pops on death for other players. DTS lib required.
body:
# Better Totem Counter

A lightweight client-side Fabric mod for keeping track of Totems of Undying — yours and everyone else's. Built for PvP.

## Features

- **Hotbar totem count** — shows how many Totems of Undying you're carrying (inventory + offhand) just above your hotbar, with a color-graded count and an adjustable size and position.
![Hud for Better Totem Counter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5ff685d95a6e71481c89a786388f5f08592f33c.png)
- **Nametag pop counter** — appends a totem icon and a colour-graded count after each player's nametag, tracking how many totems they've popped this life (green → yellow → red as it climbs).
- **Reset on death** — a player's count resets when they die, using layered detection: server death messages (which work server-wide) plus a nearby fallback.
- **Reset key bind** — bind a key, or use the in-menu button, to clear all counts at once.
- **In-game settings** — toggles, a scale slider, and drag-to-reposition, all under the **Dotshow Mods** button in the pause menu.

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader 0.16.9+
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [DTS Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/dtslib) — required; provides the in-game settings hub.
